module.name: @spark-appworks/spark-lowcode-api:realtime/data-entry/ai-data-entry-session
module.jsdoc:
@module @spark-appworks/spark-lowcode-api:realtime/data-entry/ai-data-entry-session
职责：持有单个真实目标 DataView 的暂存式 AI 批量录入会话，协调输入、正式 Agent 轮次、候选查询、确认与安全释放。
边界：轮次命令沿同 DataSet 的 AiTurnResource/DataView 提交；确认只向原目标 DataView 暂存新增行，不保存业务数据，也不自建权限或字段真源。
AI用途：页面或标准组件需要创建、查询、停止并确认一批 AI 候选时，使用本会话公共合同；组件卸载只应 detach 订阅，不得销毁仍有待核验状态的 owner。

AiDataEntryAdapter.name: AiDataEntryAdapter
AiDataEntryAdapter.jsdoc: Synchronous domain preflight and optional asynchronous append hooks bound to the exact target view.

methods.name: readContext
methods.jsdoc: Return only business context needed by this batch; this callback must not perform I/O or return hidden data.

methods.name: validateBatch
methods.jsdoc: Validate domain rules for the whole batch before any target row is added. Must be synchronous and side-effect free.

methods.name: appendBatch
methods.jsdoc: Append the prevalidated batch to the same target DataView. Partial additions remain in its original draft.

AiDataEntrySessionInput.name: AiDataEntrySessionInput
AiDataEntrySessionInput.jsdoc: Dependencies for one session; the caller supplies the existing AiTurnResource for this same DataSet.

attributes.name: dataSet
attributes.jsdoc: The current runtime DataSet that owns the target and shared AI turn views.

attributes.name: targetView
attributes.jsdoc: The staged business DataView that will receive confirmed rows.

attributes.name: turnResource
attributes.jsdoc: The already-created turn owner whose four views must belong to dataSet.

attributes.name: agentId
attributes.jsdoc: The configured formal Agent ID, validated against the existing Agent catalog before each create.

attributes.name: adapter
attributes.jsdoc: Optional narrow synchronous domain context/preflight and asynchronous append adapter bound to targetView.

AiDataEntrySession.name: AiDataEntrySession
AiDataEntrySession.jsdoc: A single active staged batch-entry conversation; its target DataView never changes after construction.

constructorMeta.jsdoc:
Binds one session to an existing DataSet, target view and shared turn owner.
It rejects immediate targets and resource collisions before creating either temporary table.

attributes.name: targetView
attributes.jsdoc: Immutable business target; all confirmed rows are staged through this exact DataView.

attributes.name: input
attributes.jsdoc: One-row static-data input view; users edit the businessPrompt field through the standard DataView editor.

attributes.name: candidates
attributes.jsdoc: Read-only query view derived from the currently verified formal turn and the current target schema.

attributes.name: turn
attributes.jsdoc: Shared formal turn DataView used for status, completion and cancellation readback.

attributes.name: turnId
attributes.jsdoc: The turn id acknowledged by the current batch, when available.

attributes.name: status
attributes.jsdoc: Status read only from the current, valid formal turns DataView row.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.jsdoc: Current async command/query activity.

attributes.name: hasUnconfirmedSave
attributes.jsdoc: Whether unresolved command captures must keep the original turn owner alive.

attributes.name: blocksWorkspace
attributes.jsdoc: Whether the original host should retain this session because an intent or result is unresolved.

attributes.name: pending
attributes.jsdoc: Any input, candidate, command or error that the host must retain for user resolution.

attributes.name: error
attributes.jsdoc: Last local error, if a completion could not be parsed or validated.

attributes.name: canStart
attributes.jsdoc: Whether a new request can be started from the current input and formal target snapshot.

attributes.name: canRefresh
attributes.jsdoc: Whether a known turn or unresolved original command can be queried without resubmitting it.

attributes.name: canCancel
attributes.jsdoc: Whether the formal turn is known and nonterminal, with no cancellation command already outstanding.

attributes.name: canConfirm
attributes.jsdoc: Whether the current read-only candidate batch passes the same preflight used by confirm.

attributes.name: confirmationError
attributes.jsdoc: User-facing reason matching canConfirm's fail-closed checks.

attributes.name: shouldAutoRefresh
attributes.jsdoc: Host polling hint based only on formal turn readback or an unresolved original command.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.jsdoc: Listens to input, candidate, target and shared turn DataView state changes; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: start
methods.jsdoc: Starts one independent turn from the current businessPrompt editing overlay in the Input DataView.

methods.name: refresh
methods.jsdoc: Reads the current turn through AiTurnResource and installs a validated completion in the Candidates DataView.

methods.name: confirm
methods.jsdoc: Confirms the current batch after a fresh all-row preflight; never saves the target DataView.

methods.name: cancel
methods.jsdoc: Sends the existing cancellation command; acknowledgement never implies a terminal remote status.

methods.name: discard
methods.jsdoc: Explicitly abandons the local prompt/candidates once no command or remote turn is active.

methods.name: dispose
methods.jsdoc: Releases only the session-owned temporary tables after all local and remote intents are resolved.
